en-US.author: VoidZero Inc. & Contributors
en-US.description: oxlint is a blazing-fast JavaScript and TypeScript linter that is 50–100× faster than ESLint. It is designed to catch erroneous or useless code without requiring any configurations by default.
en-US.name: oxlint
